active_campaign.title: MENTAL FORTITUDE
active_campaign.label: ACTIVE CAMPAIGN
active_campaign.description: Surging Voteless populations on key planets have triggered an emergency joint Helldiver and SEAF campaign. The Ministry of Truth views it as an opportunity to support SEAF with preemptive mental health treatments to prevent Illuminate mind control. Fight the Illuminate and their baseless propaganda.
active_campaign.description_cn: 关键星球上的无票者数量急剧膨胀，绝地潜兵与SEAF需要紧急发动联合战役。真理部将此事件视为一个机会，通过先发制人的心智健康疗法支援SEAF，抵御光能者的精神控制。对抗光能者及其毫无根据的宣传攻势。

phases.title: MENTAL CLARITY
phases.briefing:
Voteless populations on ALAMAK VII and ALAIRT III are increasing unexpectedly. Frontline SEAF exposed to their vile dogma report an inability to resume optimal performance.

To combat this scourge, the Center for Mental Clarity (CMC) is to be built on ZEA RUGOSIA, where innovative mental health treatments spearheaded by the Ministry of Truth will preemptively protect SEAF personnel from Illuminate mind control, and all forms of Tyrannical brainwashing.

Helldivers are ordered to kill 215,000,000 Voteless to aid this valuable study, and to hold ZEA RUGOSIA to establish the CMC ahead of the fight against the Voteless.
phases.briefing_cn:
天大将军一VII和艾列尔特III上的无票者数量正在出乎意料地暴涨。无票者的邪恶信条深深影响了前线的SEAF，他们报告称，自己无法拿出最佳的战斗表现。

为了对抗这场灾难，我方即将在泽亚鲁戈西亚建设心智澄明中心（CMC），施行由真理部主导的创新心智健康疗法，抢先一步保护SEAF人员，抵御光能者的精神控制，以及所有形式的暴政洗脑。

绝地潜兵奉命击杀215,000,000个无票者，协助这项宝贵的研究，还要守住泽亚鲁戈西亚，完成CMC的建设，为针对无票者的战斗做准备。

phases.title: FIELD SALVAGE
phases.briefing:
With ZEA RUGOSIA secured, construction of the CMC is underway with construction forces composed of SEAF on an outdoor wellness retreat. 

Super Earth continues to monitor the Voteless population spikes on ALAMAK VII and ALAIRT III. The continuing enemy surge requires far greater SEAF presence to support the Helldivers, increasing demand for the production of the neural implants. While expensive, each implant costs several Super Credits less than training new SEAF, and is considerably more affordable than implementing radical work-life balance countermeasures.

To further lower the project's economic impact, Helldivers are ordered to eliminate 135,000,000 Troopers, 2,000,000 Factory Striders, 250,000,000 of Terminids and 25,000,000 Bile Spewers.
phases.briefing_cn:
泽亚鲁戈西亚已被肃清，CMC的建设随之开展，施工队伍由SEAF组成，工程选址在一处户外康养度假地。

超级地球还会继续监控天大将军一VII和艾列尔特III上的无票者数量激增现象。由于敌人发起了持续的猛攻，我方需要更多的SEAF兵力来支援绝地潜兵，从而增加了对神经植入物生产的需求。虽然植入物的成本十分昂贵，但是比起训练新的SEAF，还是能节约一点超级货币，而且比实施激进的“工作与生活平衡”应对措施要便宜得多。

为了进一步降低该项目的经济影响，绝地潜兵奉命消灭135,000,000名新兵、2,000,000座移动工厂、250,000,000只终结族以及25,000,000只胆汁喷涌虫。

news.original:
SYSTEM OUTAGE UPDATE
Some Helldivers may have noticed a recent service error in the Major Order Communication Display. The issue has since been resolved (details below).
[SYSTEM ERROR REPORT #8.03.529]
Cause: Stray bullet hit central data relay.
Discussion: Truth Enforcer in-field execution had dissident facing the wrong wall.
Resolution: Electronics replaced. Family of dissident fined for damages. 
[END REPORT]
news.translated:
系统故障更新
部分绝地潜兵可能已注意到，重要指令通讯显示屏近期出现服务错误。该问题现已解决（详情见下）。
[系统错误报告 #8.03.529]
原因：流弹击中中央数据中继器。
讨论：真理执行者现场处决时，让异见分子面错了墙。
处理：电子元件已更换。异见分子家属因损坏设备被处以罚款。
[报告结束]

[SYSTEM ERROR REPORT #8.03.529] Cause: Stray bullet hit central data relay. Discussion: Truth Enforcer in-field execution had dissident facing the wrong wall. Resolution: Electronics replaced. Family of dissident fined for damages. [END REPORT]

news.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON 

Both orders were successful and as a result, construction of the CMC began on schedule and without issue. Early reports from the mental health initiatives show promise, with SEAF personnel especially appreciating therapeutic activities such as the Illuminate live-fire range. The neural implant tested well at the prototype phase and will move to full production immediately.
news.translated:
重要指令已完成

两项指令均已成功，因此，CMC的建设会按计划顺利开始。心智健康倡议的早期报告显示出了积极的前景，SEAF人员特别赞赏了光能者实弹射击场等治疗活动。神经植入物在原型阶段的测试结果良好，将会立即进入全面生产。
news.official_message: 重要指令已完成 两项指令均已成功，因此，CMC的建设会按计划顺利开始。心智健康倡议的早期报告显示出了积极的前景，SEAF人员特别赞赏了光能者实弹射击场等治疗活动。神经植入物在原型阶段的测试结果良好，将会立即进入全面生产。

NEW MAJOR ORDER 

Helldivers are ordered to hold ZEA RUGOSIA, the planetary base for the Center for Mental Clarity (CMC). 

Helldivers are also ordered to kill 215,000,000 Voteless to develop the experimental therapeutic program. The Ministry of Truth knows that the Helldivers will rise to the occasion.

新重要指令

绝地潜兵奉命坚守泽亚鲁戈西亚，即心智澄明中心（CMC）的行星基地。

绝地潜兵还需击杀215,000,000名无票者，协助开发实验性治疗项目。真理部坚信，绝地潜兵一定能迎难而上。
news.official_message: 新重要指令 绝地潜兵奉命坚守泽亚鲁戈西亚，即心智澄明中心（CMC）的行星基地。 绝地潜兵还需击杀215,000,000名无票者，协助开发实验性治疗项目。真理部坚信，绝地潜兵一定能迎难而上。

news.original:
DSS BACK TO REGULAR OPERATION

The DSS is resuming standard operation procedures at the hands of the Helldivers after having concluded authorized FIREBREAK PROTOCOL across the surface of GACRUX.

Helldivers can now resume collective control of the Democracy Space Station via the Galactic Map. Use it to defend our way of life and Managed Democracy.
news.translated:
民主空间站恢复常规运作

经授权，火线阻断协议已在十字架一地表执行完毕。此后，民主空间站将回归绝地潜兵掌控，恢复标准运作流程。

绝地潜兵现可通过银河地图，重新集体控制民主空间站。用它捍卫我们的生活方式，捍卫受控民主。
news.official_message: DSS BACK TO REGULAR OPERATION The DSS is resuming standard operation procedures at the hands of the Helldivers after having concluded authorized FIREBREAK PROTOCOL across the surface of GACRUX. Helldivers can now resume collective control of the Democracy Space Station via the Galactic Map. Use it to defend our way of life and Managed Democracy.

news.original:
MAJOR ORDER FAILED

Though the Helldivers successfully repelled the primary Terminid swarm, the uncooperative fascist insects prevented the full deployment of the Firebreak Protocol, with fewer Terminid-infested planets purged of their affliction than intended.

In response, full production of the Incinerator FRV has commenced, to be ready for when the mutated strain of Terminids next raises its ugly head.

未完成重要指令

尽管绝地潜兵成功击退了终结族虫群的主力，但顽固不化的法西斯昆虫还是阻碍了防火带协议的全面部署，导致已清除终结族侵扰的星球数量低于预期。

作为回应，炽灼型快速侦察载具已进入全面生产，以备丑恶的终结族变种再次作乱。

news.original:
DSS FIREBREAK PROTOCOL

The planetary purification of ACAMAR IV has reached satisfactory levels. With orbital firing corridors now secured above GACRUX, the DSS will continue FIREBREAK PROTOCOL there until similar sanitation levels are achieved.

Helldivers are expected to regain control of the DSS once FIREBREAK PROTOCOL is complete.
news.translated:
DSS 防火协议

天园六IV 的星球净化已达到令人满意的水平。随着 十字架一 上空的轨道射击走廊现已得到保障，DSS 将在该地继续执行防火协议，直至达到同等卫生水平。

防火协议完成后，绝地潜兵应重新夺回 DSS 的控制权。

The Democracy Space Station will be temporarily unavailable while performing planetary purification from orbit.

Helldivers are expected to regain control of the DSS once FIREBREAK PROTOCOL is complete.

news.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Thanks to the Helldivers’ superior frontline productivity, full containment of the mutated Terminid strain is within reach. To cleanse affected planets of their infestation, High Command has authorized the Firebreak Protocol.

To enable this innovative proactive solution, Helldivers must Hold ACAMAR IV, GACRUX and PARTION, to secure orbital firing corridors until the necessary purification is complete.
news.translated:
新重要指令

得益于绝地潜兵卓越的前线效率，全面管控终结族变种已经指日可待。为了净化受感染行星上的虫患侵扰，最高指挥部已授权执行防火带协议。

为了实施这一创新性的主动解决方案，绝地潜兵必须坚守天园六IV、十字架一和帕尔晨，确保轨道火力走廊的安全，直至必要的净化工作完成。
news.official_message: 新重要指令 得益于绝地潜兵卓越的前线效率，全面管控终结族变种已经指日可待。为了净化受感染行星上的虫患侵扰，最高指挥部已授权执行防火带协议。 为了实施这一创新性的主动解决方案，绝地潜兵必须坚守天园六IV、十字架一和帕尔晨，确保轨道火力走廊的安全，直至必要的净化工作完成。

news.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

In a showcase of their unyielding valor and mastery over thermal firepower, the Helldivers have successfully repelled the mutated Terminid offensive from their primary targets.

However, infestation vectors continue to increase exponentially. The Ministry of Science has declared a Tyrannical Pandemic, the first in over a century.
news.translated:
重要指令已完成

绝地潜兵展示了不屈不挠的勇气，向敌人倾泻热能火力，成功击退了变异终结族的进攻，没有让它们完成主要目标。

然而，侵扰矢量仍在呈指数级增长。科学部宣布，暴虐瘟疫已爆发，这还是一个多世纪以来的首次。

news.original:
STRATEGIC ADVISORY

All Helldivers should factor the following advisory into their strategic decision-making:

Enemy forces stage their attacks on our planets from an originating planet. Liberating the originating planet will end the enemy attack immediately.

In the current operational context, liberating GRAND ERRANT would end the current TERMINID attacks upon ACRUX IX, GEMMA and POLARIS PRIME.
news.translated:
战略预警

全体绝地潜兵在做战略决策时都应该考虑以下建议：

敌人从起源星球向我们的领地发起进攻。解放起源星球将立即终止敌人的攻势。

在当前情况下，解放大艾伦特就能终止当前蟲族向十字架二IX、贯索四以及北极星主星发起的进攻。
news.official_message: 战略预警 全体绝地潜兵在做战略决策时都应该考虑以下建议： 敌人从起源星球向我们的领地发起进攻。解放起源星球将立即终止敌人的攻势。 在当前情况下，解放大艾伦特就能终止当前蟲族向十字架二IX、贯索四以及北极星主星发起的进攻。
